Hi Aisha - great to meet you on the call. Recap and next steps below.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II program. The most recent Type II report covering our relevant controls (security & availability) is in progress and targeted for completion in July 2026; we can share a SOC 2 summary and readiness letter now.
- Incident response / notification: our standard customer notification SLA is to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirmed incidents that meet our notification criteria. We also send an initial acknowledgement within 24 hours if an investigation is ongoing.
- BCP / DR: we run annual tabletop exercises and quarterly failover validation for critical services. Last tabletop exercise: March 2026. We can share the BCP summary and the after-action report redacted for internal details.

Attachments and links I'll share in the next email:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary + readiness letter)
- bcp-incident-response-timeline.pdf (incident notification timeline & escalation matrix)
- link to secure Drive folder with redacted AARs and DR test evidence

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll upload the three artifacts to the shared drive and send you a link (target: EOD Monday).
2) Marissa will complete the vendor questionnaire sections that touch procurement and SLAs.
3) If you need the full SOC 2 report we can provide it under NDA/secure portal - flag if procurement needs it now.

Looping Marissa here to acknowledge assignment.

Thanks,
